Count vessels by ocean, flag, gear, and year

get_n_vessels.Rd

Queries the ace.A_ACE table for vessel counts, optionally filtered by ocean, flag state, gear type, and/or year. Filters are built via .sql_filter(), so any parameter left as NULL is excluded from the WHERE clause rather than matched literally.

Usage

get_n_vessels(
  ocean = "WX",
  flag = NULL,
  gear = NULL,
  year = NULL,
  group_species = FALSE,
  group_flags = FALSE,
  group_gears = FALSE,
  include_size_classes = FALSE
)

Arguments

ocean

Character. Ocean code to filter on. NULL (default) returns all oceans.

flag

Character. Flag code to filter on. NULL (default) returns all flags.

gear

Character. Gear code to filter on. NULL (default) returns all gears.

year

Integer. Year to filter on. NULL (default) returns all years.

Value

A data frame (or tibble, depending on db_query()) with one row per ocean/flag/gear/year combination, giving ocean_code, flag_code, gear_code, year, and n_vessels.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_n_vessels(ocean = "ATL", year = 2023)
get_n_vessels(flag = "ESP", gear = "PS")
} # }
